about_the_game: The first two shifts of Some Assembly Required, showing off gameplay, enemies, graphics and configuration, and the beginning of the story of Regenix Corporation and it's parent entity.

content_descriptors.notes: Some Assembly Required contains slight gore (dismembered body parts that you collect, blood splatters, zombies), and some strong language.
